title: 2008 HMMT November General Round 1 Problem 5
statement: Joe has a triangle with area \(\sqrt{3}\). What's the smallest perimeter it could have?

solutions.text: 6 The minimum occurs for an equilateral triangle. The area of an equilateral triangle with side-length \(s\) is \(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{4} s^{2}\), so if the area is \(\sqrt{3}\) then \(s=\sqrt{\sqrt{3} \frac{4}{\sqrt{3}}}=2\). Multiplying by 3 to get the perimeter yields the answer.
